title: docs: update ROADMAP.md for 2026 milestones
body:
## What does this PR do?

Updates `ROADMAP.md` to:
- Mark completed milestones in 2025 Q3 (Podman 5.6 release and Podman 6 HLD).
- Add the 2026 Q1/Q2 roadmap section (Podman 5.7, 5.8, Podman 6.0 planning, Quadlet/machine enhancements).
- Link to the public GitHub Milestones page and issue tracker for live feature tracking.
- Fix minor typographical errors (`importantance` -> `importance`, `RESTFUl` -> `RESTful`).

## Why?

The roadmap had not been updated past 2025 Q3 and left older release milestones unchecked.

Fixes #28288

## Testing

Verified rendered markdown formatting and file links.

comments.body: I don't think this is really appropriate; a lot of the things from the backlog are still ongoing/not complete
